title: The scalar spectral index comes from projection, not inflation

statements.text: The scalar spectral index of the early universe is a geometric projection from a 9D bulk to a 6D brane through a fold operator, not a product of stochastic fluctuations in inflation, and the framework gives $n_s \approx 0.9649$, consistent with Planck 2018 data.

sources.quote: yielding a theoretical value of n_s \approx 0.9649 consistent with Planck 2018 data
